record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the first convolution's GELU branch in each NextItNet block with a gated causal convolution: produce 2H channels, split into a and b, and use a*sigmoid(b) before existing dropout and the second convolution. Learned gates may suppress irrelevant contextual signals more selectively than fixed residual scaling. Preserve dilations, residual addition, embeddings, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer and checkpoint shapes consistently; retain one model per category.
